websiteHub.title: Choose the model that fits you.
websiteHub.intro: One-time development or Website as a Service: you decide how you want to start.

oneTime.title: Websites with a fixed starting price.
oneTime.intro: A one-time investment for designing and building your website.
oneTime.note: Introductory prices exclude 21% VAT. The final price depends on scope, features, and selected services. You always receive a clear quote in advance.

waas.title: Industry-focused websites, all-inclusive.
waas.intro: Website, hosting, and maintenance in one monthly subscription, tailored to your industry.
waas.note: Prices exclude 21% VAT. Exact scope is aligned during the intro call. Website as a Service has specific terms on ownership, transfer, and termination. See our Terms & Conditions for details.

hosting.title: Yearly hosting, without the hassle.
hosting.intro: Fast, secure hosting with SSL, backups, and personal support.
hosting.note: Prices exclude 21% VAT. You always receive a clear proposal in advance.

maintenance.title: Maintenance as a subscription.
maintenance.intro: Ongoing care for updates, monitoring, and support.
maintenance.note: Prices exclude 21% VAT. Minimum term depends on the selected contract. Duration and cancellation terms depend on the chosen plan.

termsInfo.title: Good to know
items: One-time websites are a one-time investment; Website as a Service is a monthly subscription.
Hosting is billed annually; maintenance according to the selected contract.
Subscriptions have a minimum term based on the chosen contract length. After that, they can be cancelled according to the terms.
The final price depends on scope, features, and selected services. You always receive a clear quote in advance.
After delivery, you receive a full walkthrough of your website.
